name: Willowcurrent Bend
introDiscord:
Long willowkelp branches bend beneath a slow silver current. Willowcurrent
Nymphs move through them like dancers, turning the water with every
gesture.
introTwitch:
Long willowkelp branches bend beneath a slow silver current. Willowcurrent
Nymphs move through them like dancers, turning the water with every
gesture.

willowcurrent-bend-approach.prompt:
Three paths curve beneath trailing willow fronds. Each bends gently
toward a different current.

left.message:
A Willowcurrent Nymph traces one hand through the water.

The current bends.

The fronds bend.

You bend slightly too.

The Nymph seems satisfied and attacks.

right.message:
An offering basket rests beneath long willow leaves. Inside are Star
Candies polished smooth by the slow current.

forward.message:
Restorative sap sits beneath Shizuki's note:

'Water here keeps moving my hair dramatically.

Excellent location.

Medicine also good.'
forward.fullHpMessage:
You leave the restorative sap untouched and enjoy the complimentary
dramatic hair current.

willowcurrent-bend-depths.prompt: Living rootways follow the bending current into three graceful arcs.

left.message:
Broad silver kelp wraps a cache caught in the curve of a willow root.
Inside are Star Candies and a tiny ribbon flowing permanently sideways.

right.message:
A Nymph redirects the current across your path with one elegant motion.

You are beginning to suspect the forest has professional choreographers.

forward.message:
One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's sketch of herself standing
dramatically beneath the willow fronds.

Caption:

'Looked mysterious for approximately eight seconds.

Glimmer ruined atmosphere by sitting on head.'

willowcurrent-bend-threshold.prompt:
Moonlit fronds bow toward Drowned Willow Shrine as three streams weave
through the roots.

left.message:
A tranquil grove pool sits where the three currents briefly calm.

Shizuki wrote:

'Rest here.

Hair drama resumes after this point.'
left.fullHpMessage:
You leave the pool untouched and prepare for continued atmospheric
hairstyling.

right.message:
A moss-covered shrine coffer rests beneath a willow arch. Star Candies
inside catch the moving light like tiny droplets.

forward.message:
A Willowcurrent Nymph steps into the current.

The entire path curves around it.

Apparently the route belongs to the dancer now.

boss-antechamber.name: Drowned Willow Shrine
boss-antechamber.prompt:
Every willow branch in the Shrine bends toward a single figure beneath
the roots.

bossPromptDiscord:
The silver current slows.

A graceful silhouette rises beneath the hanging willowkelp, and every
smaller Nymph stops moving.

Water gathers around the figure like a long flowing veil.

Use /yes to enter Drowned Willow Shrine or /no to leave the ancient
current undisturbed.
bossPromptTwitch:
The silver current slows.

A graceful silhouette rises beneath the hanging willowkelp, and every
smaller Nymph stops moving.

Water gathers around the figure like a long flowing veil.

Use !yes to enter Drowned Willow Shrine or !no to leave the ancient
current undisturbed.
bossRetreatText:
You step away. The willow current resumes its slow path through the
forest.

boss.revealText:
The hanging fronds part as a powerful Nymph rises within a spiral of
silver water.

Weeping Current Nymph reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Weeping Current Nymph dissolves back into the willow stream.

The branches straighten slightly.

Then one current catches your hair.

Atmosphere restored."
